Morgan: Morning team — quick async check for the content calendar and bench posts. Please drop a 1-2 line update: what you did yesterday / blockers / today. We're consolidating copy + benchmarks for the launch page. I'll update the doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-content (please add numbers inline). Ping Eng for any PRs that need reviews.

Jordan: Yesterday — finished draft of benchmark narrative and CTA ideas. Blocker — missing perf numbers for quantized v2 from eng. Today — slot social copy + finalize hero copy once numbers in. @Lin can you share the CSV?

Lin: Pulled metrics this AM and exported CSV to the doc (section: "metrics -> raw"). PR reference: `#462` contains the measurement harness. Blocker — saw a memory regression on quantized v2 at long sequences causing slower throughput, investigating with eng-runtime.

Devon: Reviewed the draft, added suggested social hooks and subject line variants. Blocker — need the hero screenshot from design (still waiting on final art). Also noted one factual nit in the benchmark paragraph — want to confirm tokenization settings.

Sasha: Sending hero asset in ~45m. FYI changed the CTA color to #0057D9 per brand update, will attach final PNG here: https://files.redwood/company/hero-final.png :white_check_mark:

Morgan: Awesome — once hero lands I'll slot it into the doc. @Jordan can you tentatively schedule the post for Tue 10am PST if Lin's numbers confirm? Also tagging eng-oncall for visibility on `#462` perf regression.

ops-bot: staging deploy: `model-bench-2` deployed by Lin at 2026-03-17T09:10:00Z. Tests: unit ✅, perf smoke tests running.

Lin: Quick update — pushed a small fix in `#463` that reduces KV cache pressure; perf improved ~12% on 2k seq in staging. Running full suite now, should be ready for review.

Jordan: Great news, thanks @Lin. I'll update the doc numbers and add the CTA link: https://redwood.ai/signup — will also add the subject line variants to the calendar event.

Devon: LGTM on copy. If staging perf holds, I'll prep the social schedule and approve launch creative.

Morgan: Perfect. Current blockers tracked: 1) final hero asset (Sasha), 2) perf regression review/merge (Lin). I'll close this thread after I update the calendar doc and mark tasks in the launch board. Thanks all :raised_hands:
